partner_result_applied.application: Replaced the partner's exact decoupled third pivot by a coupled null-direction square transform in L^3_t(L^2_y), retaining the partner rank-two Plancherel credit.

new_result.scope: Disjoint original coordinate sets |I|=2, |J|=3; rank(A[I,J])=2 with singular product Delta>0; null vector n has delta=n^T A[J,J] n !=0; arbitrary outside couplings/eigenvalues and arbitrary independent densities <=1.

external_source_applied.citation: Livshyts--Paouris--Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, arXiv:1507.07949
external_source_applied.used_statement: Any k-dimensional marginal of a product probability density with one-dimensional factors bounded by one has density at most 2^(k/2); k=1 was used after an affine shear.

unresolved_implication: From only three eigenvalues |lambda|>=1, aggregate either a rank-three cross-block resource or a coupled 2x3 resource with Delta^3 delta^2 bounded below at dimension-free scale, or extend the mixed-norm theorem to a high-cardinality aggregate null direction. Additional eigendirections remain able to cancel a three-mode cross block.
next_step: Seek an exterior-algebra/random-cut identity for the combined rank-two cross-volume times null-direction curvature, paying the reciprocal constant only after aggregation; test on Walsh/Hadamard and hard-saddle families.
